name: Time Off
source:
Time Off is a short story about a pair of craftsmen taking the day to relax and get familiar with a few drinks. Works hard and stresses a relationship; sometimes, you need to take a break.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/time-off-short-76516077]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Time Off》是一个关于两位工匠抽出一整天时间放松身心、小酌几杯增进了解的短篇故事。繁重的工作会给感情带来压力；有时候，你需要歇上一歇。

[引自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/time-off-short-76516077]Patreon[/url]]
